250-779-1479-5411-8338.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5411-8338.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5411-8338.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

339-677-728-8296.description:

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2645-3430-3664-5475.description:

Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

767-2033-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-2033-4687.description:
Activate Citanul Hierophants by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.

Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.

814-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3967-4484-4668-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3967-4484-4668-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
3967-4484-4668-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3967-4484-4668-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

Repeat.

413-725-1336-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 5 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
413-725-1336-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0}.

957-3662-5131.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {3}{R}{R}{R} each extra turn
957-3662-5131.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard.
Move to your second extra turn.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Time Stretch from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Cast Izzet Chemister from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

3094-5637-5657--34.manaNeeded: {2}{C}{C} plus enough mana to pay for the Eldrazi spell
3094-5637-5657--34.description:
Cast an Eldrazi from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Ulalek triggers, the Eldrazi cast triggers if it has a cast ability, and Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, Ulalek's trigger, the Eldrazi cast trigger if it had one, and the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger.
Resolve the Eldrazi cast trigger, if applicable.
Resolve the copy of the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, Ulalek's trigger, the Eldrazi cast trigger if it had one, and the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

437-486-509-2751-4131.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Sphinx's Disciple to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 6.

Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.

Resolve the Syrix trigger, causing you to pay {2}{B}{R} to cast Syrix from your graveyard.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Slogurk leaves the battlefield, returning three lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
